summary: SK hynix Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a board-approved new facility investment to construct the M17 fab in Cheongju, Korea, for approximately KRW 19.1 trillion (about 15.83% of total equity as of Dec 31, 2025). The investment aims to secure mid- to long-term memory semiconductor production capacity. Construction runs from August 7, 2026 to April 30, 2031. This is a routine capital expenditure disclosure, not a special situation; the registrant acts as the filer reporting its own organic expansion. No deal terms apply.
